values.name: __drill_window__
values.description: ISO 8601 interval describing the restore-drill window being evaluated. Supplied by the scheduler that triggers this playbook (cron, Temporal schedule, or n8n trigger), or by an operator-initiated trigger.

values.name: __backup_scope__
values.description: Identifier of the in-scope data set for this drill (matches a row in the operator's documented backup-scope catalogue: which systems, which datasets, RPO/RTO band).

values.name: __candidate_backup_id__
values.description: Identifier of the most recent backup artifact selected for the drill, resolved against __backup_scope__ and the drill window.

values.name: __integrity_ok__
values.description: Outcome of the validate-backup-integrity step: true when the backup's documented integrity checks (checksum, manifest, decryption key availability) all pass; false when any check fails. A false value short-circuits the drill into the evidence-capture and notify branches with a failure record rather than executing the restore.

values.name: __drill_result__
values.description: Identifier of the executed restore-drill artifact: the durable record of the non-destructive restore exercise (target environment, restored object inventory, RTO/RPO observed). Empty when the drill was skipped due to a failed integrity check.

values.name: __attestation_id__
values.description: The dated backup-attestation + drill-evidence record, keyed by its attestation_id (sha256 of workflow_id|execution_id|captured_at). Always populated, including the integrity-failure branch (which emits an attestation recording the failure with verdict integrity-failed).

values.name: __backup_inventory__
values.description: The operator's backup inventory for candidate selection: {"backups": [{backup_id, scope, completed_at}, ...]}. Produced by the operator's own backup tooling before the run; handed in as data so trigger resolution is pure and replayable.

values.name: __integrity_observation__
values.description: The operator's integrity-check observation for the candidate backup: {backup_id, manifest_verified, decryption_key_available, checksums: [{object_ref, expected, observed}, ...]}. The checks run in the operator's tooling; this playbook evaluates what they reported.

values.name: __drill_observation__
values.description: The operator's restore-drill observation: {backup_id, scope, target_ref, completed_at, production_isolated, restored_objects: [{object_ref, verified}, ...]}. production_isolated must be exactly true — the drill evaluator refuses observations that cannot prove isolation.

values.name: __owner_binding__
values.description: The continuity owner's pre-bound delivery channel: {channel_kind: ticket|chat|email, address_ref, owner_role}. address_ref is an opaque operator-owned reference (queue id, channel id, mailbox alias) — never a person in the clear.

values.name: __continuity_notification__
values.description: The composed owner notification, emitted with dispatched: false. Dispatch along the bound channel is the runtime's job; composing it deterministically is this playbook's.

values.name: __workflow_id__
values.description: Runtime-context: id of the compiled workflow executing this playbook. Supplied by the target runtime; part of the house attestation-id derivation.

values.name: __execution_id__
values.description: Runtime-context: id of this execution. Supplied by the target runtime; part of the house attestation-id derivation.

values.name: __captured_at__
values.description: Runtime-context: ISO 8601 instant the evidence was captured. Supplied by the target runtime so primitives never read a clock; part of the house attestation-id derivation.

nodes.name: detect restore-drill trigger
nodes.notes: Resolve the trigger for this run: a scheduled drill window matured (cron / Temporal schedule), an operator-initiated drill request landed, or a continuity event up the chain raised the drill cadence. Reads __drill_window__ and __backup_scope__ and selects __candidate_backup_id__ — the most recent backup artifact for the in-scope data set that is eligible for a non-destructive drill against an isolated target.

nodes.name: validate backup integrity
nodes.notes: Run the documented integrity checks on the candidate backup: checksum / manifest verification, decryption-key availability against the operator's key-management surface, and a presence check against the documented backup-scope inventory (no silently-dropped objects). Sets __integrity_ok__. A false outcome short-circuits the drill into the evidence-capture step (failure attestation) without executing the restore, so the operator's continuity owner is notified of the integrity gap rather than discovering it under real recovery pressure.

nodes.name: backup integrity ok?
nodes.notes: Branch on __integrity_ok__. True branches into the non-destructive restore-drill execution; false routes straight to evidence capture (failure attestation) and notify, recording the gap without executing the restore against potentially-corrupt data.

nodes.name: execute restore drill
nodes.notes: Execute the non-destructive restore drill against the operator's documented isolated drill target (not production). Restore the in-scope objects from __candidate_backup_id__, record the observed RTO / RPO against the documented objectives, capture the restored object inventory, and emit __drill_result__. The drill is non-destructive by construction; production state is untouched. Detection bindings for restore-target misconfiguration (restore landing in production, drill target reachable from production network) are owned by CORE-layer cards once upstream rule ids are selected. The drill's dated attestation feeds kpi.restore_drill_attestation_freshness@v1, pinned on this step and on evidence capture since the EXTEND card landed the catalogue wiring.

nodes.name: evidence capture

parameters.pythonCode:
from content.playbooks.backup_recovery.primitives.attestation import build_drill_attestation
__attestation_id__ = build_drill_attestation(workflow_id=__workflow_id__, execution_id=__execution_id__, captured_at=__captured_at__, backup_scope=__backup_scope__, candidate_backup_id=__candidate_backup_id__, integrity_ok=__integrity_ok__, drill_result=__drill_result__, integrity_observation=__integrity_observation__)

nodes.notes: Compose and publish the dated attestation + drill-evidence record to the operator's evidence store. The record carries the candidate backup id, integrity-check outcome, executed drill result (or the failure marker for the short-circuit branch), observed RTO/RPO, restored inventory, and the drill window. This is the audit-evident artifact that NIS2 Art.21(2)(c) and DORA Art.12 reviewers read; missing or stale attestations are the failure mode the metrics surface.

nodes.name: notify continuity owner
nodes.notes: Deliver the attestation reference to the continuity owner along the operator's pre-bound channel (ticketing system, chat thread, email). Tracked as a distinct step so the evidence-capture artifact and the human-acknowledgement record can be audited independently; an attestation written but never delivered to the owner is itself a continuity gap.
